summary.zh: 同一个“要保存修改吗？”对话框，六种成对的进场 / 退场：果冻弹出、从一条线展开、从按钮长出来的气泡、三张卡洗牌、从天上掉下来、从 Dock 里吸出来再收回去。黑白线稿，只看动效本身。
summary.en: One “Save your changes?” dialog, six paired entrances and exits: jelly pop, unfold from a line, a bubble that grows out of the button, a shuffled card stack, a drop from the sky, and a genie-ish pop out of (and back into) the Dock. Black-and-white line art, so only the motion speaks.

technique.zh: 每种方式就是一对 WAAPI 关键帧。果冻：阻尼弹簧采样，scaleY 比 scaleX 晚 3 帧，差出来的那半拍就是“抖”。气泡 / Dock：先量出按钮或图标相对对话框的位移，从那里缩放出来；Dock 再叠一个梯形 clip-path 当“漏斗”。掉落：ease-in 下落、落地压扁、再小跳一下，背景跟着震。焦点在对话框里循环，Esc / 点遮罩关闭，关完焦点回到触发按钮。
technique.en: Each style is a pair of WAAPI keyframe sets. Jelly: a sampled damped spring with scaleY lagging scaleX by 3 frames — that half-beat is the wobble. Bubble / Dock: measure the trigger’s offset from the dialog and scale out of it; Dock adds a trapezoid clip-path as the funnel. Drop: ease-in fall, squash on landing, a small hop, the background shakes. Focus is trapped, Esc / scrim click closes, focus returns to the trigger.

desc.zh: 进场基准时长（各方式按比例缩放）

adapt.zh: 挑一种喜欢的直接用：每种都是一个 enter() / exit() 函数，换到自己的 <dialog> 上就行。退场一定要比进场短。
adapt.en: Pick one and use it: every style is just an enter() / exit() pair you can drop onto your own <dialog>. Keep exits shorter than entrances.
